steps.content: [Fraser Hotel] [Heavy Fade to Black]
Boundless darkness fills the room.
Days of isolation, of restricted and drugged meals, have depleted Hypatia's strength to its limit.
Creak.
(Screen turns completely white)
Blinding light floods through the doorway, followed by heavy footsteps. Hypatia raises her head, the sudden glare stinging her eyes, and in its wake, a wave of dizziness overtakes her.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: Suspect Hypatia, you stand accused of conspiring with DisCity to detonate the Black Ring, causing widespread catastrophe. I am conducting this interrogation on behalf of the Fraser Senate.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: I trust these days of confinement in darkness have helped you see your situation clearly. I expect you have reflected on your actions.
At last.
A beep from a recording device sounds near her ear.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Hypatia Campbell</color>, Chief Aurum Secretum Researcher of the Luminaris Society. You are believed to be directly involved in multiple catastrophic incidents, including the explosion at the Aurum Secretum Research Institute and the detonation of BR-005. Furthermore, you are suspected of treason for selling core Aurum Secretum secrets to DisCity.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: Do you confess?
Only silence answers him.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: Your silence is futile. We possess irrefutable evidence of your actions.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: Prior to the BR-005 detonation, our networks were breached, severing communications between Fraser and the Institute. Among the decrypted tools used by the hacker, the coding methodology bears a resemblance to the programming techniques employed in the Fraser Kardas. One string of code even points directly to you.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: Furthermore, after the war broke out, you were repeatedly observed at salons and hotels affiliated with the DisCity ambassador, Margaret Kervoz. Shortly thereafter, DisCity forces obtained detailed intelligence regarding our latest Aurum Secretum technology and BR-005's vulnerabilities. Our analysis confirms that such knowledge could only originate from the Chief Researcher of the Luminaris Society.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: How do you explain this? Or do you expect us to believe it is a mere coincidence?

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: It is an utter disgrace! The hopes of generations within the Farland Alliance... betrayed by you so easily, vanished in an instant. Every sacrifice, wasted for nothing!

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: What possessed you? Did Margaret Kervoz deceive you with her pretty lies about "peace"? What stories did she feed you?

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: DisCity has never truly sought peace! Their hands are stained with blood debts dating back to the DisCorps era. Since the control of the Hypercube, they've only shown complete disregard for the farlands' survival, obsessed only with maintaining their monopoly.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: When they ravaged the farlands, who provided shelter? Who established the WhiteSands trade routes and painstakingly purchased Hypercubes from DisCity to share with those small states? It was us, Fraser!

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: And you, a citizen of Fraser, conspired with them, sabotaged our Black Ring project, and show not a shred of remorse!

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: If...
Hypatia breaks her silence. It is the first time she has spoken since the interrogation began.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: If Fraser truly honored its pledge to work for the welfare of the farlands, it would, as I have been, devoted to quelling calamities. It would never permit the farlands to cultivate a Black Ring, much less weaponize it.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: The suffering of the farlands stems from calamities, hardships only worsened by the Black Rings. As a researcher, my duty is to study and eliminate them.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I have neither sold their secrets nor betrayed those people.

steps.speaker: Interrogator
steps.content: DisCity was the first to weaponize a Black Ring. The forced detonation of BR-005 and its theft were executed by DisCity's Sinner, Hella. These are the very crimes you denounce. Fraser has always maintained a neutral position, condemning such actions.
The Interrogator speaks with fervent, unshakable conviction, every word ringing with pride. It is a zeal Hypatia recognizes... which mirrors her own from long ago.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Is that so?
She offers a faint, weary smile.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Then I hope the senators can find rest at night, undisturbed by the weeping of the farlands' vengeful spirits.
Afterwards, no matter what the Interrogator asks, Hypatia remains silent.
A long while later, having failed to extract a single word, the interrogator stops the recording with a resentful scowl, storms out of the room, and slams the door hard behind him.
[White light fades, back to the normal room]
Once the interrogator's footsteps fade into the distance, Hypatia quickly rises to her feet.
She knows the Senate's methods all too well. While she endured this round of questioning, the next would be even more cunning and cruel. She must escape, and soon.

She darts to the door and extends a finger. A golden thread seeps from her fingertip, creeping through the narrow gap beneath the tightly shut door. Moments earlier, when the interrogator entered, she had guided a trace of Aurum Secretum into the keyhole, preventing the door from locking fully.

Guided by her will, the golden thread coaxes the heavy iron door open just enough to create a slim opening. Carefully, she unfastens the Campbell brooch from her collar and gently traces the engraved petals. The Aurum Secretum within flows along the patterns, reshaping into a delicate, spider-like form. Then, the little creature scuttles through the gap, its vision now streaming back to her.
This brooch is one of the few items of Aurum Secretum she still retains. The inspectors had dismissed it as a mere "ornament"—a gesture of concession, out of respect for the Campbell family.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Hmm... two guards on patrol. Any blind spots... Difficult, but not impossible. The real question is where to go once I'm out...

The Senate, in the end, did not dare imprison her in a true cell or interrogation block. Instead, they have confined her in a remote, secured hotel, a choice that unwittingly provided her with a far more convenient path to escape.
The Aurum Secretum spider tilts its head upward, its gaze revealing a maintenance hatch set into the ceiling.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Just as I recalled from the architectural archives. Fraser's older structures utilize central air systems with ceiling vents for heat dissipation.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Their requisition was rushed. They wouldn't have had time to seal every auxiliary duct. That oversight is my opportunity.

The Aurum Secretum spider scuttles silently across the ceiling to the air vent. Its slender, needle-like legs make short work of the grating, slicing through the metal. A moment later, a resilient thread unspools from its body, dropping down into the shadows below.
Hypatia stares into the newly opened darkness. The gloom of the passage seems to breathe back at her, and a memory stirs.
(Flashback)

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Ahhh fine! I get it!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Fine, I'll crawl through this stupid pipe!
(End of Flashback)

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I never imagined I'd find myself doing something similar now.
Furor... At the very thought, a wave of tenderness washes over her. Those days feel both impossibly distant and startlingly near.
No. She cannot afford this now.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: The window is brief. I'll move on the next blind spot in their patrol... I must be quick.
